scope: Primary general MEA rules, locally reconsulted ME2 manual, rejection of a non-PDF ME3 response, and clearly separated secondary catalogue assertions for six models and DLC contexts. No gameplay, catalogue or historical report changed.

facts.finding: Research unlocks blueprints; augmentations are incorporated during crafting and may change equipment behaviour.
facts.doesNotEstablish: Any particular augmentation, rank, original value or model compatibility.

facts.finding: Ryder can select available weapon categories without a category restriction; weapon weight affects power recharge. Two squadmates accompany Ryder, with some missions imposing a squadmate.
facts.doesNotEstablish: Every companion weapon allowance or any model/scenario availability and weight value.

facts.finding: Weapon mods are selected at loadout; Fusion Mods attach to chest armour and may have trade-offs.
facts.doesNotEstablish: A port count, particular mod, original bonus, or permission to place crafting augmentations or Fusion Mods in weapon ports.

facts.finding: The general weapon HUD shows shots remaining and reserve; R reloads. Ammo caches replenish ammunition.
facts.doesNotEstablish: That all specialist models use this general system, or their capacities and reserves.

facts.finding: Numbered powers use finite Power Cells replenished at ammo caches and have no recharge time. Unnumbered powers have recharge times.
facts.doesNotEstablish: Which named powers use cells, their original quantities, or an ATB action economy.

facts.finding: Skills mix Combat, Biotics and Tech; up to three powers are assigned. Profiles unlock through investment and confer boosts. Squad loyalty unlocks top-tier skills.
facts.doesNotEstablish: Complete companion kits, recruitment contexts, exact ranks, original boosts, or a unique canonical Ryder class.

facts.finding: Multiplayer supplies include Cobra RPG, revival, ammo/Power Cell refill and health/shield refill; use per match is limited.
facts.doesNotEstablish: Single-player inventory/reward rules or exact quantities for each supply.

primaryDocuments.limit: No model entry or description of Remnant weapon overheating or beam mechanics was found in this manual. This is a limit of the document, not proof of absence in the game.

findings: Removable heat sinks and replacement with remaining-shot display (printed16–17).
